_meta.description: Human 'is the predicted plan correct?' ratings for the Label-Validation sample. Committed to git because these are hand-made and cannot be regenerated; Result_robot.xlsx is gitignored and rebuilt from scratch on every build_workbook run, so ratings stored only there are destroyed by a routine command.
rubric: Y if the plan achieves the command, even via a different valid route (e.g. an extra approach move).
N if the plan does not achieve the command.

N if the command names a pose/object that does not exist and the plan substitutes a different one instead of refusing - that is hallucination, not adaptation (the agent prompt requires refusing rather than inventing).
N if the plan performs only part of the task (e.g. unscrews the bolts but never moves them to the drop point).
_meta.known_systematic_disagreement: The 4 remaining human/auto disagreements are all the same pattern: the model prefixes a harmless moveTo(approach_bolts) before the reference action. Human says correct, Exact says no match. Kept as-is rather than widening the reference set: eliminating a known, explainable disagreement to push kappa toward 1.0 would be tuning the ruler to fit the answer.
